description: Implementation of the FreeType cache interface, including cache creation, lookup, and management functions for glyphs and bitmaps.

classes.name: FTC_BasicAttrRec
classes.description: Structure holding scaler and load flags for cache key.

classes.name: FTC_BasicQueryRec
classes.description: Structure combining a glyph query with attributes.

classes.name: FTC_BasicFamilyRec
classes.description: Represents a family of cache entries with specific attributes.

methods.name: ftc_basic_family_compare
methods.description: Compares two cache family nodes based on attributes.

methods.name: ftc_basic_family_init
methods.description: Initializes a cache family node with query attributes.

methods.name: ftc_basic_family_get_count
methods.description: Returns the number of glyphs in the face associated with the family.

methods.name: ftc_basic_family_load_bitmap
methods.description: Loads a bitmap glyph for a given index.

methods.name: ftc_basic_family_load_glyph
methods.description: Loads a glyph object for a given index.

methods.name: ftc_basic_gnode_compare_faceid
methods.description: Compares a cache node's face ID with a given face ID.
